description: Embedding-based search over EU legislation at article granularity. Returns relevance-scored article hits with parent CELEX, article reference, and law title. Requires a paid LexAPI plan; returns 403 on FREE tier.

filters.description: Optional filters passed through to the LexAPI semantic backend. See the LexAPI docs at https://lex-api.com/docs for accepted filter keys (e.g. documentType, author, language, dateFrom, dateTo).

name: lex_semantic_legislation
